product.title: Teton Views Scenic Float Trip

description.text: The Snake River is an ideal location to see some of Wyoming's beautiful flora and fauna—especially bald eagles, ospreys, and pelicans—near Grand Teton National Park. Rather than rush down the river on a whitewater or kayaking trip, float down a scenic 13-mile (21 kilometers) stretch of the river on an easygoing raft. Stops include Lewis & Clark River Expeditions, Wilson, Grand Teton National Park, Bridger Teton National Forest, Snake River Range, Southpark Boat Ramp.
